//: Type-checks the TEST tree, which `tsconfig.typecheck.json` deliberately excludes.
That exclusion meant ~4,300 tests were never type-checked, so a test could assert
on a field that does not exist and pass by asserting nothing. That is not
hypothetical: this config's first run found a stress test reading
`totalCrimesCommitted` off GameState (no such field), another reading
`legacy_builder`) that the perks type does not have. It is the same class of
defect as the weekly challenges that read `c.owned` and `c.employees.length` on
shapes the game never writes — two 250/300-gem challenges that were
mathematically impossible to complete. 2026-07-30 audit ARCH-2.
`noUnusedLocals`/`noUnusedParameters` are off here for the same reason they are
off in tsconfig.typecheck.json: an unused import in a test is lint's job, and
191 of the 398 raw errors were that noise, drowning the 201 real ones.
Run via `npm run type-check:tests`. The CI gate is `npm run type-check:tests:ratchet`
earlier revision of this comment named), run on every PR via eas-update.yml. Its
baseline is now 0 — the backlog is burnt down, so the gate is simply "the test
tree must type-check". Do not raise the baseline to get unblocked.
